sources.name: ESPN, NBA 75th Anniversary Team ranked 1-76 (expert panel, voted on head-to-head matchups; panel size not stated)
Sports Illustrated, 50 Greatest NBA Players of All Time (SI staff)
Complex, 30 Best NBA Players of All Time (4 authors)

changes_vs_current: Dropped Nikola Jokic and Giannis Antetokounmpo (only the 2024 and 2026 lists have them; ESPN 2022 and SI 2016 omit or predate them, which penalizes both: Jokic avg 43.5, Giannis 32.0). Added Charles Barkley and Isiah Thomas. Curry slides from 11th to 15th, Bill Russell and Kobe move up a few spots, Larry Bird to 6th. Ties at 19.0 (Durant, Karl Malone, Erving) broken by median rank.
confidence: medium. All 4 sources list every item in the top 15 and the top ~10 order is very stable across them. Weaknesses: only 2 of the 4 are real expert panels (ESPN, SI); ClutchPoints and Complex are writer lists. Two sources are stale (SI 2016, ESPN 2022), so active stars (Jokic, Giannis, Curry, Durant) are underrated; ranks 16-24 are within about 1 point of each other, so treat them as a cluster. I could not read a large fan vote: Ranker returns 401 and the Athletic's NBA 75 is paywalled. Cross-check only (not in the average): The Athletic's 2024 poll of 133 NBA players (via CBS Sports) had Jordan 45.9%, LeBron 42.1%, Kobe 9.8%, which is consistent with the top 3 here. ESPN's 2016 #NBArank top 10 (same outlet as source 1) also agrees.
